findings.message: The forms registrarDespesa, corrigirDespesa, enviarParaAprovacao and reenviarParaAprovacao had no <command>.input state. Added the four drafts registrarDespesaInput, corrigirDespesaInput, enviarParaAprovacaoInput and reenviarParaAprovacaoInput (type DespesaDraft, every leaf nullable) with their setters set<Id>.

Param despesaId selects detalheDespesa, but no function writes the selection and no query fetches one expense by id. The state detalheDespesa holds the id. Added public selectDetalheDespesa(id | null) and the getter detalheDespesaItem, which returns the loaded row. The getter cannot be named after the organism because that name is the state id.

The commands return only id, version and details, with no status. After enviarParaAprovacao and reenviarParaAprovacao the status of the row in minhasDespesas stays stale, and so does reenvioRealizado after reenviarParaAprovacao. A newly registered row is inserted with status 'draft' and reenvioRealizado false. pageStatus stays 'empty' after the first expense is registered, because only the initial load writes it.
The list paging metadata (hasMore, page) had no state in the defs. Added the state hasMoreListaMinhasDespesas and published the page param from the output page. The page size is a constant.
The organism formularioDespesa mentions a comprovante (proof), but no contract input has a field for it. The shared sends no proof and the backend rule proofRequiredBeforeSubmission decides.
